decision: Upgraded ghostty-web from stable 0.4.0 to the newest published build 0.4.0-next.20.g1858a59 (npm dist-tag `next`, commit 1858a59, 2026-06-28) — 20 commits ahead of v0.4.0 (9e4e126, 2025-12-08). Pinned EXACTLY (no caret/range) because `next` is a floating dist-tag: a range would silently drift to future prereleases. Same upstream project (github.com/coder/ghostty-web); no fork or library swap.
context: A local checkout at ~/prj/dx/3rd-party/ghostty-web is clean on origin/main at that same commit; comparison confirmed it is the same package, not a more mature alternative. No v0.5.0 exists — release-please automation only landed inside this very delta, so `latest` is still 0.4.0.
tradeoff: This moves daax from a stable release to a prerelease channel. Accepted on operator direction. Reversible in one commit (re-pin to ^0.4.0).
delta: lib/ +1932/-166 across 15 files: mouse tracking for TUI apps (#106), crash-on-resize-during-high-output fix (#132), echo latency reduction (#179), scrolled-row cell clearing wasm fix (#180), OSC8 hyperlink click (#117), triple-click selection (#115), Shift+Tab backtab (#112), bracketed-paste (#99), device-attributes response (#101), Safari/Firefox copy fixes (#94), transparent background (#116), runtime export of Key/KeyAction/Mods/DirtyState (#130), Android support (#110).
api_compat: init(), Terminal, FitAddon all still exported; Terminal still exposes open/write/writeln/loadAddon/focus/dispose/cols/rows and the onData IEvent — the full set GhosttyTerminal.tsx uses. No source changes were required.
blast_radius: Ghostty is opt-in on /shell only (default terminal type is xterm). AI-coding sessions run components/terminal/Terminal.tsx (xterm.js) via TerminalManager and are unaffected by this bump.
tests_added: tests/components/ghostty-web-api-surface.test.ts (contract test: the component types the module as `any`, so an upstream rename would ship silently); tests/e2e/terminal-ghostty.spec.ts (opens a Ghostty tab on /shell and asserts the canvas mounts, which only happens after await init() instantiates ghostty-vt.wasm). The ghostty path previously had ZERO test coverage.

verification_method: A/B against baseline: stashed the dep bump, reinstalled 0.4.0, re-ran the full unit suite and the 3 failing e2e specs to prove every failure pre-exists the upgrade.

decision: Cross-provider validation run before push: produced by Claude Opus 5, validated by Codex CLI 0.147.0 (GPT-5.x, read-only sandbox). Verdict: APPROVE WITH NOTES.
codex_confirmed: Exact pin is correct and package.json/bun.lock/installed package all resolve 0.4.0-next.20.g1858a59, so the floating `next` tag cannot cause drift; the installed .d.ts provides every API GhosttyTerminal.tsx uses; no upgrade-specific WASM/CSP/addon risk — stable and prerelease both use the same embedded-data-URL-first wasm loader with file fallbacks, and next.config.ts already grants 'wasm-unsafe-eval'.
codex_finding_actioned: The contract test asserted only exports and prototype methods, leaving the consumed onData/cols/rows unasserted — they are instance members set in the constructor, so their removal would have passed both new tests. A code comment also wrongly claimed instantiation requires WASM. Fixed: ITerminalOptions.ghostty is the library's documented test-isolation hook, so the test now constructs a Terminal with a stub ghostty instance (no WASM load) and asserts cols/rows are numbers and onData returns a disposable — the component keeps that disposable and calls dispose() on unmount. Incorrect comment removed. Contract test is now 4 cases.
